title: Land O' Many Mons (LOMM)
description: This adds fun fakemon to minecraft, as well as letting you submit your on fakemon on our website!
body: Welcome to LOMM! We are a small group, and are just starting this project, but here is the sum of the project. We take your subbmissions and impliment them into cobblemon via resource/datapack combo. Visit [our website](https://cobblemonlandomanymonsdatapack.my.canva.site/lommo-intro) for more.
